verdicts.reason: Both are the same strip layout. The headline reads well, but both photos are shrunk into tiny, hard-to-read thumbnails, and the 'ONLINE TRAINING BY / FREYA ANOUK' labels are too small to read and float loose at the far right, away from the headline. In A, the yellow accent is only a stray sliver behind 'BEST', a small, awkward leftover. In B, the yellow blocks sit on top of the left photo and cover the woman, a clear unwanted collision with a busy image, so A is slightly less broken.
